body: Happens all the time. The best way to counter it is to keep as few items on you as possible. The more items you have then the more data the server has to send back and forth.

body: When I get froze like this I turn data and Wi-Fi off and turn them back on. It forces the game to reconnect and it seems to get me back in the fight sooner

author: Issues3220
body: It happens a lot in the evening. I experimented with changing networks and minimizing/maximizing. When it happens you should minimize the app, and click it's icon to launch (do not close the game and not maximize from background, just click the app icon on the desktop). This gets the game going sometimes. Worst case scenario - kill the game, launch again.
